name: Blightbreaker doubles Mercy's tick rate and mana cost (#733)
contract: Blightbreaker 707433 carries two ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (aura 108) effects, both classmask (32,0,0) in family 33: effect 0 MiscValue 19 (SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME), EffectBasePoints -51 -> CalcValue -50 (DieSides 1); effect 1 MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST), EffectBasePoints 99 -> CalcValue 100. Mercy 504848 is SpellFamilyFlags_1 32 in family 33, matching that classmask exactly (707433 is absent from the family-33 override switch in SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod at SpellInfo.cpp:1500, so plain classmask matching applies); its own periodic-trigger effect (aura 23, EffectAmplitude_1 3000 ms, ManaCostPercentage 21) is what the two modifiers act on. AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodic (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:718) applies SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME to the amplitude at aura-apply time (3000ms * (1-0.50) = 1500ms), and SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost (SpellInfo.cpp:3065) applies SPELLMOD_COST to the mana cost through the same Player::ApplySpellMod path (cost * (1+1.00) = double). Both effects are engine-native SpellMod paths (AuraEffect::HandleNoImmediateEffect for auras 107/108, implemented in AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod) with no dedicated handler required; Blightbreaker only needs to be learned (Attributes 192 includes SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE 0x40, and Player::addSpell auto-casts passive spells on learn) for its SpellModifier to register.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Mercy's base tick rate without Blightbreaker
Mercy's base mana cost without Blightbreaker
Test casts Mercy on itself with Blightbreaker known
Blightbreaker halves Mercy's tick interval (doubles its tick rate)
